propositions: The provenance test assertion fails because it searches for the raw uppercase Jira key (e.g. RBJNAZV-1) in the ticket JSON, but the local ticket id is lowercased (jira-rbjnazv-1) by _jira_key_to_local_id, making the case-sensitive substring match impossible

The raw Jira key does not appear in the ticket payload itself; it is only recorded in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return, so the test cannot validate the DC-to-local correspondence using only the ticket object
The test must be fixed to match against the exact ticket id derived from _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally assert that the binding store maps that local id to the remote key
A unit test must independently verify that _jira_key_to_local_id lowercases and prefixes correctly, so the test's id derivation is pinned outside the live harness
